verdict.rationale: Vestd claims board-ready equity governance with deed/witness signatures and custom document templates, plus digital share authorisation and data rooms for storing documents. That suggests resolutions could be drafted and signed in-platform, but nothing explicitly describes board consents or shareholder approvals being routed for e-signature or archived against the transactions they authorise. Missing for 10: explicit board consent/shareholder resolution drafting workflow, documented e-signature routing to directors and shareholders, linkage of signed approvals to specific share issuances or grants, independent or hands-on corroboration.
